newsitem.title: USA: Alternative Resources Q4 net up, alliances formed.
newsitem.headline: Alternative Resources Q4 net up, alliances formed.

text.p: Alternative Resources Corp on Wednesday reported a six-percent increase in its net income in the fourth quarter ended December 31 and announced two new alliance partnerships.

The company said it posted profits of $3.6 million in the period, compared to $3.4 million one year ago thanks to higher profit margins. Revenues reached $52.4 million, versus $44.5 million in the fourth quarter of 1995.

Meanwhile, Alternative Resources signed an alliance with National TechTeam Inc to jointly market information services, and with DeVry Inc aimed at offering career development to DeVry students and alumni.
Its shares closed down two Wednesday at 15-3/8.
